title: Balanced Bundles
description: Changes the default bundle recipe to require two string and six leather, for better early game balancing.
body:
Bundles are a massively helpful new (as of 1.21.2) item for inventory management and expansion. They're very convenient. Maybe too convenient.

This data pack changes the recipe for bundles from requiring one string and one leather to requiring two string and six leather, to make them a little harder to obtain early on. This is the same recipe as that from [Vanilla Tweaks's craftable bundles](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/crafting-tweaks/).

Generated via [misode's Recipe Generator](https://misode.github.io/recipe).
